data.body: Consideration: [Reliability] Before flipping enforcement.strategy=ci, run `bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh` and confirm .github/required-checks.txt lists every CI check-context name that must block merges (including the parity-uplifted llm-review job). If the file is missing entries, the CI ruleset will not actually block violations and SC3 (in story 733f-938c-e6d9-464d) will produce a false-pass. Done sub-item: required-checks.txt validated against current workflow `name:` fields with no drift before commit of the flip.
